discovery_partitions_price_bounds_ordere.name: discovery_partitions_price_bounds_ordered
discovery_partitions_price_bounds_ordere.value: "discovery_partitions"."price_from_cents" IS NULL OR "discovery_partitions"."price_to_cents" IS NULL OR "discovery_partitions"."price_from_cents" < "discovery_partitions"."price_to_cents"

product_media_sources_dimensions_non_neg.name: product_media_sources_dimensions_non_negative
product_media_sources_dimensions_non_neg.value:
("product_media_sources"."byte_size" IS NULL OR "product_media_sources"."byte_size" >= 0)
        AND ("product_media_sources"."width_pixels" IS NULL OR "product_media_sources"."width_pixels" >= 0)
        AND ("product_media_sources"."height_pixels" IS NULL OR "product_media_sources"."height_pixels" >= 0)

product_offers_compare_at_requires_evide.name: product_offers_compare_at_requires_evidence
product_offers_compare_at_requires_evide.value: "product_offers"."compare_at_amount_minor" IS NULL OR ("product_offers"."comparison_evidence_id" IS NOT NULL AND "product_offers"."compare_at_currency" IS NOT NULL)

product_offers_pricing_state_explained.name: product_offers_pricing_state_explained
product_offers_pricing_state_explained.value:
("product_offers"."pricing_state" = 'RESOLVED' AND "product_offers"."pricing_resolver_version" IS NOT NULL AND "product_offers"."price_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("product_offers"."pricing_state" = 'UNRESOLVED' AND "product_offers"."pricing_unavailable_reason" IS NOT NULL)

product_revisions_frozen_when_settled.name: product_revisions_frozen_when_settled
product_revisions_frozen_when_settled.value: "product_revisions"."workflow_state" NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED') OR ("product_revisions"."content_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "product_revisions"."frozen_at" IS NOT NULL)

product_revisions_approved_records_mode.name: product_revisions_approved_records_mode
product_revisions_approved_records_mode.value: "product_revisions"."workflow_state" <> 'APPROVED' OR ("product_revisions"."approval_mode" IS NOT NULL AND "product_revisions"."approval_policy_version" IS NOT NULL AND "product_revisions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

product_variants_dimensions_non_negative.name: product_variants_dimensions_non_negative
product_variants_dimensions_non_negative.value:
("product_variants"."weight_grams" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."weight_grams" >= 0)
        AND ("product_variants"."length_millimeters" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."length_millimeters" >= 0)
        AND ("product_variants"."width_millimeters" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."width_millimeters" >= 0)
        AND ("product_variants"."height_millimeters" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."height_millimeters" >= 0)
